description: She wears a deep red full-length gown with a low square neckline, a fitted paneled bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Gold-toned floral embroidery and woven border bands decorate the bodice, straps, sleeve edges and long outer skirt borders. A narrow waist belt has round metal ornaments. A cream-and-gold patterned underdress shows at the front below the waist, while matching red and cream draped cloth rests around her forearms and falls beside the skirt. A small pendant necklace, subtle earrings and brown closed shoes are visible. Fabrics are opaque and richly textured, with a velvet-like outer sheen; precise fibers are uncertain. Upper chest and forearms show, with bust, abdomen and pelvis covered.
